placesHint: Pick where the video starts (A) and where it ends (B). Use a country, a city or coordinates like 28.61, 77.21.
noMatch: No match. Try another spelling, or type coordinates such as 28.61, 77.21.
highlightHint: Colours each country you start, stop at or end in.
caption: Title on the video (optional)
captionPlaceholder: For example: Delhi to New York
keepOpen: Keep this screen on and stay on this page while the video records. It takes as long as the video.
webmNote: This browser saves WebM video. It plays in Chrome, Edge and Firefox. If an app does not accept it, open this page in Chrome on a computer or a recent Android phone and save again, or convert the file.
noRecord: This browser cannot record video. You can still preview and save a picture. Try a recent Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox to make the video.
slowNote: Your device drew {fps} pictures a second, below 30. The video is the right length but may look less smooth. Choose 720p or a shorter length for a smoother result.
failed: The video could not be made. Try 720p or a shorter length, and keep this page open while it records.
sameStops: Start and end are the same place. Choose two different places.
fps: 30 frames a second. No watermark. Made on your device, nothing is uploaded.
smoothHint: Draws every frame one by one, so the video is smooth and sharp even on a slow phone. It can take longer than the video itself.
quickHint: Records while the globe plays, so it takes as long as the video. A slow phone may skip frames.
fpsSmooth: {fps} frames a second, every frame drawn. No watermark. Made on your device, nothing is uploaded.
keepOpenSmooth: Drawing every frame: {done}% done, about {left} seconds left. Keep this screen on and stay on this page.
smoothNote: Saved as an MP4 file with every frame drawn, at {fps} frames a second.
